table.name: TLGNR_PRINTER_BS
table.description: Reference data table for the Printers within Crh. A printer has a (human readable) name, and an URI (address) on which it can be contacted from the Logon application server. If different types of printers (different abilities, protocols, levels) need to be distinguished, add to this table as well. Currently printers are configured per loadingpoint (to define where delivery notes are printed, if needed), but may be needed for other kind of documents at other places as well in future releases.

column.name: PRINTER_NAME
column.description: Human readable name (identifier) of the printer, e.g. 'HOLSIP01-S1', 'CHE-MUN-P002'.

column.name: PRINTER_URI
column.description: The full address/URI of the printer, e.g. 'ipp://192.168.94.132/ipp'.

column.name: PRINTER_TYPE
column.description: Free text brand/type description of the printer. Not used technically, just additional information for a user/administrator.

column.name: PRINTER_COMMENT
column.description: Description/Comment about the printer, such as where it's geographically located, paper type, etc. Not used technically, just additional information for a user/administrator.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
